name: store_analyzer
description: Parse a WooCommerce System Status Report or REST export and score store health across catalogue, payments, shipping, tax, performance, and security. Returns findings and the top risks.

system_status.description: WooCommerce System Status Report as text or JSON.

plugins.description: Active plugin slugs with versions, e.g. 'woocommerce 9.3.1'.

focus_areas.description: Optional subset of areas to prioritise.

name: setup_optimizer
description: Produce an ordered setup-optimisation plan from a store analysis. Each item includes impact, effort, and a rollback note.

analysis.description: Output of store_analyzer, or an equivalent findings object.

business_model.description: Primary business model driving checkout and account settings.

regions.description: ISO country codes the store sells to (for tax/shipping).

name: product_configurator
description: Recommend product types, global attributes, category structure, and inventory policy for a catalogue.

name: payment_integrator
description: Design a gateway matrix, webhook checklist, and PCI DSS scope statement for the store.

regions.description: ISO country codes to accept payments from.

average_order_value.description: Average order value in the store's base currency.

preferred_gateways.description: Gateways the merchant already uses or prefers.

flow.description: Integration flow, which determines PCI SAQ scope.

name: performance_optimizer
description: Turn a measured performance baseline into an ordered optimisation plan with target Core Web Vitals.

hosting.description: Hosting tier / stack, e.g. 'managed WP, PHP 8.3, Redis available'.

name: inventory_manager
description: Define stock-management policy, thresholds, and out-of-stock behaviour.

name: customer_manager
description: Configure customer accounts, roles, GDPR data export/erase, and transactional email branding.

gdpr.description: Whether GDPR export/erase and retention rules apply.

name: analytics_setup
description: Define the KPIs the store will track and the tracking source for each, with privacy/consent notes.

tools.description: Analytics tools in use, e.g. 'WooCommerce Analytics', 'GA4', 'Matomo'.
